item.title: Devils vs Red Wings: Detroit's Do-or-Die Playoff Push in Home Finale
item.description:
The Devils vs Red Wings matchup on April 11, 2026 wasn’t just another late-season game — it was the most consequential home game Detroit has played all year. With only three games remaining and a three-point deficit to the Ottawa Senators for the final Eastern Conference Wild Card spot, every shift carried elimination-level stakes.

Key Takeaways

  • Detroit (41-29-9, 91 points) needed a win to keep playoff hopes alive against New Jersey (40-36-3, 83 points)
  • A Red Wings loss combined with an Ottawa win would officially end Detroit’s postseason push
  • Patrick Kane has been scorching hot: 23 points in his last 17 games
  • Dylan Larkin delivered a hat trick and an assist in Detroit’s previous outing against Philadelphia
  • Devils lost defenseman Luke Hughes for the rest of the season to an undisclosed procedure

Detroit Red Wings Fight for Survival in Wild Card Race

The math is brutal and simple for the Red Wings. Sitting at 91 points with three games left, Detroit trails the Ottawa Senators (42-27-10, 94 points) by three points in the battle for the second Eastern Conference Wild Card berth. The Boston Bruins (43-26-10, 96 points) hold the first Wild Card spot.

item.title: Bruins vs Blue Jackets: A Pivotal NHL Playoff Race Showdown
item.description:
With only single-digit games remaining in the 2025–26 NHL regular season, every point matters — and few matchups carry as much weight as Bruins vs Blue Jackets. These two Eastern Conference wild card contenders squared off on Sunday, March 29, with just three points separating them in the standings. Here’s everything you need to know about this critical late-season clash.

Quick Summary:

  • The Boston Bruins (41-24-8, 90 pts) held the first Eastern Conference wild card spot heading into Sunday’s game.
  • The Columbus Blue Jackets (38-24-11, 87 pts) sat in the second wild card position, just three points behind.
  • Boston entered riding a four-wins-in-five-games surge; Columbus had dropped three of four in regulation.
  • A regulation win for Columbus would have closed the gap to a single point; a loss would have pushed it to five.

Why This Bruins vs Blue Jackets Game Was a Must-Win

The math was painfully simple for Columbus. After losing three of their last four games — including a deflating 3-2 defeat to the San Jose Sharks on Saturday that snapped a 12-game home point streak — the Blue Jackets saw their playoff odds nearly cut in half.

item.title: San Jose Sharks Playoff Hopes Fade as Five-Game Losing Streak Bites Hard
item.description:
San Jose Sharks Playoff Hopes Fade as Five-Game Losing Streak Bites Hard

After spending most of the 2025–26 season firmly in the Western Conference playoff conversation, the San Jose Sharks are watching their postseason dreams slip away at the worst possible time. A brutal five-game losing streak has left the team scrambling with just weeks remaining in the regular season.

Key Takeaways

  • The Sharks sit at 32-31-6 (70 points), five points behind Nashville for the second wild card spot.
  • A five-game winless skid has derailed a season that exceeded preseason expectations.
  • Key injuries to Tyler Toffoli, Ryan Reaves, and others have thinned the lineup at the worst time.
  • With only 14 games remaining, every point matters — and the margin for error is nearly gone.

So how did a team that surprised the hockey world end up on the outside looking in?
